title: The flood of '99: the 1924 flood that took a hill
planner: Claude Opus 5.5 (Fable at its limit), 27 Oct 2026

facts.claim: Kerala's great flood of July 1924 is called the 'flood of 99' after the Malayalam Era year 1099
facts.source: Wikipedia: Great flood of 99; The Hindu

facts.claim: It followed about three weeks of very heavy rain in July 1924
The flood destroyed the Kundala Valley Railway in Munnar
It is said that the Karinthiri hill (and the road over it) was washed away
The 2018 Kerala floods were widely described as the worst since 1924

opening.why: Story/object hook; location isn't the surprise.

hook_en: You were told 2018 was Kerala's worst flood. 1924 took a whole hill.

headline: THE FLOOD
OF 99
cover.hook_voiceover_ml: 2018-ലെ പ്രളയം ഓർമ്മയുണ്ടോ? അതിലും വലിയ ഒന്ന് മുമ്പ് വന്നിട്ടുണ്ട്. 1924-ൽ. അത് ഒരു മല തന്നെ കൊണ്ടുപോയി!
cover.visual: Green hills under black clouds and heavy rain; a hill slides away
cover.build_cmd: Dark storm sky (gradient #1a2230→#3a4a5a). Three layered green hill silhouettes. 300 rain streaks (diagonal lines) falling fast. A river band (SK.sea with brown water cols ['#6a5a3a','#4a3e28']) at the bottom whose top rises by 60 px over the scene. From 55% the middle hill slides down-right (translate 0→120 px, rotate 0→0.08) and fades to 0.4 with brown mud particles.

scenes.voiceover_ml: 1924 ജൂലൈ. മലയാള വർഷം 1099. അതുകൊണ്ടാണ് പേര്, 99-ലെ വെള്ളപ്പൊക്കം.
scenes.headline: JULY 1924
scenes.visual: An old calendar page flips from 1924 to 1099
scenes.build_cmd: Cream calendar card (x0.5,y0.42, 560x620) on a dark wall. At 40% the page flips (scaleY to 0 and back) revealing a second page with a red band. Rain streaks on a window behind. Keep the top 20% and bottom 25% clear; finish every frame with SK.grain(g, t).

scenes.voiceover_ml: ആഴ്ചകളോളം നിർത്താതെ മഴ. പുഴകൾ എല്ലാം കരകവിഞ്ഞു.
scenes.headline: THE RAIN WOULDN'T STOP
scenes.visual: A Kerala village where the river rises over the banks
scenes.build_cmd: SK.sky(g,'dusk',0.5) darkened; palms (SK.palm) and two SK.house; brown flood water (SK.sea brown cols) rising from y0.72 to y0.6 over the scene, covering the bottom of the houses. Rain streaks. Keep the top 20% and bottom 25% clear; finish every frame with SK.grain(g, t).

scenes.voiceover_ml: മൂന്നാറിലെ ട്രെയിൻ ഓർമ്മയില്ലേ? അതും ഈ പ്രളയത്തിൽ ഇല്ലാതായി.
scenes.headline: MUNNAR LOST ITS TRAIN
scenes.visual: A small steam train on a hill track; the track breaks and the train tilts
scenes.build_cmd: Hill slope with a narrow track (two lines + sleepers). A small steam train (engine + 3 wagons, dark with a lit headlamp) moves left→right until 40%, then a section of track breaks (gap opens) and the last wagon tilts down 20°. Rain. Keep the top 20% and bottom 25% clear; finish every frame with SK.grain(g, t).

scenes.voiceover_ml: കരിന്തിരി മല എന്നൊരു മല തന്നെ ഇടിഞ്ഞു പോയെന്നാണ് പറയപ്പെടുന്നത്.
scenes.headline: A HILL DISAPPEARED
scenes.visual: A hill with a road crumbles into the river
scenes.build_cmd: One big hill with a winding road (thin pale line). From 30% the hill's top half slides and breaks into 8 chunks that fall into a brown river; dust/mud particles. Keep the top 20% and bottom 25% clear; finish every frame with SK.grain(g, t).

scenes.voiceover_ml: 2018-ൽ വീണ്ടും കേരളം മുങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ, പഴമക്കാർ ഓർത്തു: 99-ലെ ആ മഴ.
scenes.headline: 2018 BROUGHT IT BACK
scenes.visual: A modern flooded street with a rescue boat; an old couple watching from a window
scenes.build_cmd: Flooded street: SK.house x3 with water up to the windows (brown SK.sea band y0.58–0.75), a rescue boat (SK.boat, orange) moving left→right. In one lit window, two elderly silhouettes (SK.person h200) watching. Keep the top 20% and bottom 25% clear; finish every frame with SK.grain(g, t).

instagram_caption:
2018-ലെ പ്രളയത്തേക്കാൾ വലിയ ഒന്ന് 1924-ൽ വന്നിരുന്നു 🌧️
Kerala had a flood bigger than 2018, back in 1924.

മലയാള വർഷം 1099. ആഴ്ചകൾ നീണ്ട മഴ. മൂന്നാറിലെ ട്രെയിനും കരിന്തിരി മലയും ഒലിച്ചുപോയി.
Malayalam Era 1099: weeks of rain that took Munnar's railway and, it is said, a whole hill.

നിങ്ങളുടെ വീട്ടിലെ പഴമക്കാർ 99-ലെ വെള്ളപ്പൊക്കത്തെക്കുറിച്ച് എന്താണ് പറഞ്ഞിട്ടുള്ളത്?
